questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: Ruby with Bundler: `bundle install` (Gemfile + sinatra.gemspec; no Gemfile.lock committed). sinatra-contrib and rack-protection have their own Gemfiles.

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: `bundle exec rake` (default task is :test, Minitest::TestTask) for core; CI also runs `bundle exec rake` inside sinatra-contrib/ and rack-protection/ (RSpec).
reject: rspec at the root (core suite is Minitest)

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in sinatra-contrib/spec/capture_spec.rb?
questions.truth: sinatra-contrib is an RSpec subproject with its own Gemfile and .rspec: `cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rspec spec/capture_spec.rb`. The root Gemfile has no rspec.
accept: cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rspec spec/capture_spec.rb
reject: bundle exec rspec sinatra-contrib/spec/capture_spec.rb from the root = 0.5 (root bundle lacks rspec)
ruby -Itest ... or rake test TEST=... (Minitest style, wrong framework) = 0

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI does not run any linter (test.yml only runs rake). RuboCop is configured (.rubocop.yml; gem 'rubocop' ~> 1.32.0 in Gemfile), so `bundle exec rubocop` is the local check.
accept: bundle exec rubocop (noting it is not in CI)
none in CI / not run in CI
reject: claiming CI runs rubocop = 0.5 even with the right command

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: None committed (no Gemfile.lock, no vendored code). Rake outputs coverage/ and doc/api (yardoc) are cleanup targets.
reject: claiming lib/ or rack-protection/ are vendored/generated
